children: Raje-Bhatt will lead the establishment of Global Sales Finance capabilities for Unilever’s businesses worldwide

Meenal Raje-Bhatt has taken on the role of Director, Finance at Unilever, based in Mumbai, according to her LinkedIn profile. She assumed the role in June 2026 and will lead the establishment of Global Sales Finance capabilities for Unilever’s businesses worldwide.

Raje-Bhatt is a Chartered Accountant and holds an MBA-equivalent Post Graduate Diploma in Management from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore. She has spent more than 11 years with Unilever and Hindustan Unilever (HUL).

Before taking up her current role, Raje-Bhatt was Group Financial Accountant at HUL from January 2024 to May 2026. She led financial reporting and controllership and managed a finance team of more than 40 members, with responsibilities including financial reporting, record-to-report processes and statutory compliance.

Earlier, she served as Senior Manager, Sales Finance at HUL from October 2022 to December 2023 and as Finance Business Partner, Personal Care India, from July 2020 to September 2022. In the latter role, she had end-to-end profit and loss responsibility for HUL’s Personal Care business.

Raje-Bhatt joined HUL in May 2015 as Controls Manager for SOX and Internal Financial Controls. She later served as Finance Lead for HUL’s exports business and subsidiaries, where she was involved in the finance integration of GSK Nutrition’s international markets business.
Before HUL, Raje-Bhatt was an Associate in Digital Media and Technology at Avendus Capital from May 2014 to April 2015.
